title: Source quality
text:
Planned checks

Latest available record date and ingestion timestamp by source
Daily record-volume changes
Missing service date and facility percentages
Invalid or missing identifier counts, reported only as aggregates
Duplicate-group and unresolved-assignment counts
Reconciliation between source, canonical-visit, pregnancy, delivery, and baby grains

title: Source quality
text:
Publication guard
Before any data frame is rendered publicly, its columns will pass assert_public_columns(). Names, NIKs, phone numbers, addresses, source JSON, and free text are prohibited from the static output.

title: INC monitoring
text:
Planned measures

INC and delivery source-record volume by date and facility
Pregnancies with delivery evidence
Delivery events and baby records as separate measures
SIGIZI-only, EPUS-only, and cross-source recording coverage

title: INC monitoring
text:
Analytical rule
A pregnancy, a delivery event, and a baby record are different grains. Counts and percentages will identify their denominator explicitly.

title: Overview
text:
Monitoring scope


ANC
Antenatal visit volume, canonical encounters, K1–K6 coverage, and source overlap.


INC
Intranatal and delivery recording coverage, with pregnancy and baby-record denominators kept separate.


PNC
Postnatal visit volume, KF1–KF4 coverage, and linkage completeness.

text:
Data boundary
This site will read approved aggregate monitoring views derived from spheres-lombok-barat.kohort_bumil_v3. Cleaning, matching, deduplication, canonical pregnancy construction, and outcome definitions remain authoritative in the birth-outcome pipeline.

title: ANC monitoring
text:
Planned measures

SIGIZI and EPUS source-record volume by date and facility
Canonical ANC encounters without EPUS cross-source double-counting
K1–K6 coverage using pregnancy-level denominators
First and latest ANC dates
Same-day source overlap and unresolved facility discrepancies
Missing visit date, facility, or pregnancy-assignment indicators

title: ANC monitoring
text:
Analytical rule
Raw EPUS_ANC and EPUS_KUNJUNGAN_IBU_HAMIL rows are source-volume measures. They must not be added together to represent unique ANC visits.

title: PNC monitoring
text:
Analytical rule
SIGIZI PNC details require a curated adapter with an explicit visit date and grain. The public website will not extract clinical fields from source JSON.
